name: Fisticuffs Synergy (Item Mastery)
body:
Your magic items make you a more effective unarmed combatant.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Improved Unarmed Strike.

Benefit(s): When you wear activated magic items that take up both the hands and feet item slots, your unarmed attack damage die increases by one step (minimum 1d6).
